title: Rotary Youth Exchange talk
summary: The Rotary Youth Exchange Program is an international student exchange program organized by Rotary clubs around the world.
description:
The Rotary Youth Exchange Program is an international student exchange program organized by Rotary clubs around the world. It gives young people an opportunity to live and study in another country while experiencing a different culture, language, education system, and way of life. The program promotes friendship, understanding, and peace among people from different nations.
A Rotary Youth exchange talk was organised for our interactors and their parents at CSV School Dharavi.
Rotarian Asmi Parikh from Dist3141 volunteered to take-up the presentation. Students and parents were curious and listened intently.
